name: PRECIOUS
summary: Out-of-reach selection by iterative refinement: a cone selects a group, which is brought closer and refined until one object remains.
howItWorks: The user casts a cone at distant objects; the selected group is moved closer and the cone is cast again on the smaller set, repeating until the target is isolated.

relationships.note: Both refine a selected group in several steps.
